title: Ethics and Compliance Counsel Specialist
jobDescription: The Compliance & Ethics Counsel Specialist for Data Privacy is responsible for conducting privacy reviews and supporting the implementation of the global data privacy program. This role requires regular communication and collaboration with internal stakeholders and external counsel. While the position involves considerable independent work, strong teamwork and communication skills are essential. Additionally, it contributes to process improvements, conducts privacy research, supports data subject rights and regulatory inquiries, and presents project updates to leadership and business teams. Responsibilities aligned to the role Draft, design, align and improve compliance processes and templates to implement different data privacy laws and other requirements that come into effect. Coordinate with different stakeholders to understand and collect process requirements and advise on approaches. Act as a project manager for new initiatives and introduce measures for existing processes and ad-hoc initiatives. Conduct data privacy assessments, such as local country risk assessments, privacy reviews and/or DP Impact Assessments, to ensure compliance with data privacy program and regulations. Support ventures & acquisitions due diligence activities, and policy administration. Understand the contractual principles required to draft, review, and assist in negotiation data privacy schedules for contractual arrangements. Monitor legal developments, regulatory changes, and global trends related to data privacy, and analyze their impact on business operations and prepare internal guidance, communications, and training materials. Draft internal support documents. Identify and support subject access/individual rights request responses in alignment with internal policies and procedures. Understand relevant Accenture policies and their application to the data privacy area, and Accenture’s business operations, regulatory environment and potential data privacy risks in regulated areas. Develop training for team members, Legal and other Accenture functions on data privacy processes or regulatory requirements. Understand the different CORE (Compliance, Operations, Regulatory & Ethics) areas and the surrounding issues and statutory regulation. Build credibility and effective relationships internally within the Legal team. Support senior data privacy counsels in operational and advisory matters.. Serve as tier 1 support to inquiries about data privacy and escalate issues appropriately. Law degree with 3–4 years of experience in data privacy. Understanding of regulatory principles governing data privacy at a global level. Fluent in English with excellent written, oral, and presentation skills. Ability to understand and design process flows and metrics. IAPP certifications, such as CIPP/E or similar are a plus. Effectively stakeholders management skills, including experience with senior leadership. Skilled in legal research, including the use of Gen AI tools. Proficiency in Microsoft Share Point, Excel, Power Point, and Word; Power BI proficiency is an advantage. Sound judgment in applying company policies, identifying risks, and escalating issues in a timely manner. Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast‑paced environment. Excellent time management, prioritization, and analytical skills. title: Corporate Investigations Counsel Manager
jobDescription:
Lead, conduct, and oversee Corporate Investigations (“CI”) arising out of alleged misconduct raised through Accenture’s various Co BE reporting channels. Reporting to Conduct & Ethics Regional Lead
- Corporate Investigator, manages notification, recording and reporting process related to investigations, and works with senior company leadership to assess and address significant legal risks associated with such reports and investigations. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Actively assist and/or conduct investigations of CI and personnel-related allegations of misconduct registered through Accenture’s various reporting channels. Oversee and conduct legally privileged investigations (at the direction of an attorney), which includes, defining scope, reviewing documentation, developing investigative plan, notifying appropriate personnel, conducting interviews, compiling investigation status and reports, recommending, and implementing proper remedial measures, concluding matters appropriately. Provide advice to organizational leadership concerning risk and appropriate remedial measures related to CI allegations. Collaborate with internal and external resources assembled to address and resolve allegations of misconduct or allegations of other improper processes/practices. Oversee, counsel, guide, train and support attorneys and other investigative personnel assembled to conduct CI-related investigations. Draft and/or review analyses to address risks of CI-related misconduct. Consult with and advise HR leadership concerning nature, risks, investigation and remediation of matters. Work with regional Corporate Investigators, Geographic Legal and HR Leads, Global and Regional Leads of internal functions, and other Global leadership on investigations. Stay abreast of legal developments affecting investigations, rights of reporting individuals, rights of accused, and compliance-related standards. Promptly identify and escalate CI matters to Regional Leads for oversight. Develop internal guidelines on CI-investigation related issues. Relationships: Reports to: Relevant Conduct & Ethics Regional Lead or Other Senior Conduct & Ethics Regional Leader. Supervises: Collaborate with local HR/ER/Legal professionals to effectuate investigations. Strong interpersonal skills, strategic business acumen, confidence and capability in addressing sensitive and complicated ethical conduct/compliance and personnel-related matters. Experience and demonstrated capability in conducting and supervising investigations (including compliance-related investigations, employment investigations, POSH, and governmental investigations) and in drafting confidential reports and advising senior leadership on such risks. In-depth knowledge of local ethical/conduct/compliance-related risks, employee rights and obligations (including POSH, LGBTQIA+, PWD, HIV et al), and related laws. Extensive experience in employee relations and workplace investigations. Team oriented, yet able to work independently. Experienced to work in a multi-national and culturally diverse environment. Ability to significantly influence senior executive management decisions; commands respect of executives. Ability to present careful, balanced, objective, lawful and well-reasoned solutions. Responsive and follows through on commitments. Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills. Ability to influence, strong executive presence. Excellent oral and written communications. Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor of Law or Higher degree. Demonstrable experience in conducting workplace/POSH and other investigations. Skills & Work Experience: For CL7: Minimum 7 years’ experience in conducting workplace/POSH and other investigations; Minimum 15 years’ experience in relevant legal function, employment law/litigation/disputes experience, and fluency in written and spoken English.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Law Experience is preferred but not mandatory. Demonstratable experience and capability in conducting and supervising investigations (including compliance-related investigations, employment investigations, POSH and governmental investigations) and in drafting confidential reports and advising senior leadership on such risks. In-depth knowledge of local ethical/conduct/compliance-related risks, employee rights and obligations, and related laws, including but not limited to Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition & Redressal) Act, 2013 and Rules framed thereunder. title: Global Trade Compliance Counsel
jobDescription:
Job Title: Ethics & Compliance, Global Trade Compliance Counsel Career Level: Manager/CL7 Career Track: Corporate Function Skill Track: Legal Job Summary: We are hiring a Trade Compliance lawyer, with 3–5+ years’ experience as a lawyer focused on trade compliance law, to serve as a subject matter expert supporting trade compliance activities under the direction of senior trade compliance leadership. Global Trade Compliance Counsel plays an important part in promoting Accenture’s compliance with international trade control requirements and regulations in the countries where Accenture does business and helps our Legal team and business to understand trade and export control related risks, compliance, and program controls. This role is an execution‑focused position that operates under the supervision and direction of the Senior Trade Compliance Counsel, Americas Lead. The role supports business stakeholders on transactional trade compliance matters in client contracts and trade‑related reviews of the company’s services and offerings, and is responsible for developing and delivering relevant trade compliance training and awareness materials, as well as tools, templates, resources, and guidance materials in alignment with established global program guidance. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Supports the implementation and maintenance of Accenture’s trade compliance program initiatives across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC regions, executing defined activities and priorities set by global and regional trade compliance leadership, including: Development and delivery of trade compliance training using approved content and frameworks. Development, review and implementation of trade policies and internal controls to support existing program requirements, subject to review and approval by senior trade compliance counsel. Planning and drafting trade compliance communications with internal stakeholders to reinforce existing policies, guidance, and escalation pathways. Working with senior management and outside counsel to conduct risk assessments, recommend improvements to the trade compliance program, and support the implementation of adopted recommendations. Working with internal stakeholders to build trade compliance and monitoring tools to escalate and mitigate trade-related risks. Working with Export Control Officers, including the Export Control Officer in India, on specialized regulated export matters. Provides objective, focused, practical advice and solutions to Accenture businesses and Legal Professionals regarding compliance with trade/export laws, Accenture’s Code of Business Ethics, Accenture’s trade compliance policies, and all other related policies. Collaborates with Legal colleagues and the business to identify, analyze and mitigate trade-related risks, and conducts localized training on trade/export law issues. Responds to and helps manage internal audits and internal investigations related to trade/export law issues. Key Relationships: Reports to: Senior Trade Compliance Counsel, Americas Lead Other Key Relationships: Legal, including Global Services Legal, Sales & Delivery, Contracting, Geographic Compliance and Corporate Counsel. Corporate Functions and business stakeholders. Market Unit leadership. Related subject matter experts (e.g., analytics, security professionals, government compliance). Privacy professionals at client and peer companies. Outside counsel/external law firms.

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
Juris Doctorate degree (or comparable legal Master’s degree) and an admitted lawyer. Work Requirements: Limited travel required as needed (usually <10%). Must have ability to effectively work with others remotely, manage a schedule with global clients and engage in contract negotiation. Knowledge and Skill Requirements: Demonstrated knowledge of international trade controls and trade/export regulatory systems around the world, including U.S. export controls. Experience supporting compliance programs, including preparing policies and internal controls; developing and conducting training; responding to government inquiries; and drafting and reviewing contracts. Ability to prioritize tasks and synthesize complex legal analysis into clear, practical recommendations. Strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills with the ability to interface, and develop relationships, with all levels of management and staff, and work cross-culturally. title: Contract Associate Manager
jobDescription:
Contract Management is part of our Legal and Commercial Services. Our professionals bring innovative ideas to commercial reality with a focus on maximizing value for all parties through a deep understanding of legal, business and commercial risks. We work alongside Accenture sales and delivery teams throughout the entire contract lifecycle to provide high quality advice and support for negotiation, drafting and ongoing management of client contracts. We apply commercial and contractual expertise to lead the delivery of legal & commercial outcomes for our priority engagements and portfolios, including: · Sales growth: expanding the footprint of our agreements and supporting new business; · Revenue protection: delivering on our contractual commitments; · Margin improvement: effectively managing commercial levers, risks and issues; and · Compliance with contract obligations and Accenture policy. KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
· Lead/support contract management teams across projects and accounts; work with account leadership, client commercial and business stakeholders to understand and support client needs and priorities; account strategy, objectives and opportunities. · Work with contract management staff across multiple projects and accounts providing input into performance management activities. · Support the identification, escalation and resolution of commercial and contract risks and issues working with CM and project leadership to ensure the best outcome for all parties. · Engage in pre-award sales activities, engage in discussions with delivery team regarding potential deal shaping and contractual outcomes with sales teams and business leadership, including contract drafting support. · The contract management function is client facing and has a key role in building trusted relationships with client counterparts.

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
· Bachelor’s degree required. Membership: · Member of World Commerce and Contracting (previously International Association for Contract and Commercial Management (IACCM)) or National Contract Management Association (NCMA) and/ or professional certification considered a plus. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS: · Experience and demonstrated capability in conducting and supervising investigations (including compliance-related investigations, employment investigations, and governmental investigations) and in drafting confidential reports and advising senior leadership on such risks. · In-depth knowledge of local ethical/conduct/compliance-related risks, employee rights and obligations, and related laws · Extensive experience in employee relations and workplace investigations · Minimum 5 yrs. relevant experience in contract management · Able to collaborate and communicate effectively with client executives at all levels of the organization · Basic understanding of commercial contracting regulations and principles, subcontracting practices; and commercial contracting terms and conditions. BEHAVIOURS AND ATTRIBUTES: · Open to work with and understand cross-cultures and locations throughout the Accenture global organization. · Understand the value of diversity and recognize the strengths that different styles, innovative perspectives and experiences bring to Accenture. · Demonstrate inclusion and respect for all individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, age, disability, culture, social status and/or sexuality. · Leader as well as team player, collaborative and persuasive; able to work well with executives and non-executives WORK REQUIREMENTS: · Some travel may be required. title: Contracting Counsel Specialist
jobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY: Review, draft, and negotiate several types of contractual agreements in a fast-paced corporate environment which may include: various type of service agreements and help senior counsel in large deals. Act, and continuously evolve as, a knowledgeable and relevant advisor on legal and commercial risks associated with transactions. KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
· Independently, and help to, structure, negotiate and close client transactions to be most advantageous from a legal and business perspective · Strategize with senior CLPs and internal business clients prior to client negotiations · Stay abreast of developments affecting the company, its clients, and industries and synthesize the information to incorporate it into company’s transactional practices · Support, promote and implement Legal Group initiatives RELATIONSHIPS: Reports to: Contracting Lead Supervises: No direct supervisory responsibility External Relationships: Accenture client executives and negotiating teams; Outside Counsel

· LL.B (or equivalent) · Authorized and licensed to practice law in India · Minimum 4 years of transactional experience in IT Industry or relevant in roles with increasing responsibility, such experience should be in a law firm or in a fast-paced corporate legal/transaction group in a relevant industry KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS: · Proven ability to efficiently manage a large volume of transactions independently; · Experience negotiating and drafting technology-based agreements; · Good understanding of contracting/risk issues, including IP, as they apply to digital, consulting, systems integration, and outsourcing transactions; and · Excellent oral and written communication skills. · BEHAVIOURS AND ATTRIBUTES: Team Player WORK REQUIREMENTS: · Travel required. · Candidates who are currently employed by a client of Accenture or an affiliated Accenture business may not be eligible for consideration. jobDescription: Role Summary The Compliance & Ethics Counsel Specialist for Data Privacy is responsible for conducting privacy reviews and supporting the implementation of the global data privacy program. This role requires regular communication and collaboration with internal stakeholders and external counsel. While the position involves considerable independent work, strong teamwork and communication skills are essential. Additionally, it contributes to process improvements, conducts privacy research, supports data subject rights and regulatory inquiries, and presents project updates to leadership and business teams. Coordinate with different stakeholders to understand and collect process requirements and advise on approaches. Act as a project manager for new initiatives and introduce measures for existing processes and ad-hoc initiatives. Support ventures & acquisitions due diligence activities, and policy administration. Ability to understand and design process flows and metrics. IAPP certifications, such as CIPP/E or similar are a plus. Effectively stakeholders management skills, including experience with senior leadership. Skilled in legal research, including the use of Gen AI tools. Excellent time management, prioritization, and analytical skills. title: Corporate Citizenship Budget and Foundation Analyst
jobDescription: This role supports both the Accenture Foundation and the Global Corporate Citizenship Budget team, contributing to the effective execution, financial stewardship, and governance of Accenture’s corporate citizenship and philanthropic activities. Corporate Citizenship at Accenture focuses on driving positive social impact through strategic investments, partnerships, and programs that advance inclusion, skills development, and economic empowerment in communities around the world. The Accenture Foundation, Inc. is a U.S.-based, nonprofit organization that advances these objectives by providing grant funding and supporting initiatives that expand access to economic opportunity, with a strong focus on employment, entrepreneurship, and resilience. Based in India, the role operates in a highly matrixed, global environment and works closely with leaders and partners across regions and time zones. The position is split approximately 50% supporting Accenture Foundation operations and 50% supporting global Corporate Citizenship budget management and reporting. The role requires strong financial discipline, operational rigor, and the ability to work independently within established governance frameworks. Key Responsibilities Accenture Foundation Support (Approximately 50%) Support the day‑to‑day operations of the Accenture Foundation, including governance, financial administration, and compliance activities Support Board and Committee governance, including preparation, coordination, and review of meeting materials, financial schedules, and tracking of actions and follow‑ups Support the grant lifecycle, including documentation, approvals, disbursements, tracking, and reporting, in line with Foundation policies and cash management requirements Prepare and maintain Foundation financial workpapers, supporting quarterly and annual reporting, audits, and governance reviews, and ensuring adherence to established controls and documentation standards Perform bank account reconciliations, investigating and resolving reconciling items in coordination with Finance and external partners, and ensuring timely and accurate cash reporting Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Tax, Audit, and external auditors to support audits, regulatory requirements, and ongoing compliance activities Maintain accurate, organized financial records, trackers, and documentation, supporting transparency, traceability, and effective Foundation governance Global Corporate Citizenship Budget Team Support (Approximately 50%) Support global Corporate Citizenship budget management processes, including actuals tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis within cash, pro bono, and DNP budgets Coordinate budget inputs from multiple regions and workstreams, including pro bono and market unit support, to ensure accuracy and timeliness Prepare financial summaries, dashboards, and materials for Global Corporate Citizenship leadership and governance forums Support quarterly and ad hoc financial title: Security Operations Center Incident Manager
jobDescription:
The Security Operations Center (SOC) Manager serves as the deputy to the SOC Senior Manager and provides operational and strategic leadership within Accenture’s Global Security Operations Centers organization. This role is responsible for ensuring performance and consistency across the three core ASOC pillars: Threat Monitoring, Building Monitoring and Alarms, and ASOC Calls. The SOC Manager also serves as the primary Travel Security Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the ASOC, helping ensure Accenture travelers in high-risk destinations are supported. This position is based in Pune, India and reports directly to the SOC Senior Manager. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead response efforts for complex, high-impact incidents affecting Accenture employees, travelers, facilities, and global business operations to include notify, assist and direct external emergency personnel and internal resources as necessary. Manage threat monitoring involving extreme weather, geopolitical instability, crime, terrorism, civil unrest, medical emergencies, and travel-related disruptions. Ensure threat monitoring is assessed, escalated, coordinated, and communicated in alignment with the GP&S Escalation Model and SOC Standard Operating Procedures. Liaise with SOC stakeholders such as Regional Protective Services, Executive Protection/Events, and Intelligence to ensure threat monitoring triggers meet their organizational needs. Establish and enforce standards for high-quality writing across ASOC products. Maintain situational awareness of high-risk travel regions and ensure delivery of timely alerts and advisories to traveling employees and stakeholders, including Mobility and Human Resources. Provide operational oversight and decision-making during active incidents to ensure timely, accurate, and effective outcomes. Act as a trusted operational partner to GP&S stakeholders and regional security leadership. Responsible for training SOC personnel to ensure competency and readiness when supporting GP&S in incident and incident response activities. Conduct thorough After-Action Reviews (AARs) after an incident and document areas of improvement and track SOC action items through completion. Conduct regular SOP reviews and updates to ensure policies and instructions provide up-to-date and clear guidance to enable an efficient response by SOC personnel. Job Requirements: Ability to work outside of business hours on short notice during critical events to include, nights, weekends, and or holidays. Preferred Skills Bias for action and strong attention to detail. Strong writing skills and experience preparing communications to be shared with senior stakeholders. Proven track record of managing high stress and impactful incidents. Experienced and independent communicator, both verbal and written. Experience with emergency response protocols and processes. Bilingual (languages in addition to English). jobDescription:

Our Contracting lawyers identify, manage and mitigate contractual risk, ensure ethical behavior and compliance with laws and company policies, while providing guidance and negotiating contracts leveraging commercial and market relevant positions. Job Summary: As Regional Legal Counsel for India, you will be responsible for leading, structuring, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating several types of contractual agreements in a fast-paced corporate environment which may include: master services agreements, outsourcing agreements, statements of work, service level agreements, licensing agreements, Saa S agreements, data transfer agreements, requests for proposals and agreements involving cloud, cyber security, artificial intelligence, systems integration and agile development. Team with more senior Contracting lawyers in supporting more complex contracts and deal structures. Act, and continuously evolve as, a knowledgeable and relevant advisor on legal and commercial risks associated with transactions. You will support Avanade, a joint venture between Accenture and Microsoft, which is a leader in cloud services, AI, and sustainable industry solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem. Avanade focuses on mid-market clients with revenues ranging from $500 million to $5 billion, providing agile and high-value IT services. In this role, you will advise business leadership on legal risks and guide clients through contracting processes. You will drive growth by winning clients with creativity and innovative legal strategies, even in smaller deals. High agility and urgency are essential to manage a high volume of deals with shorter cycles and shifting priorities. You will make informed decisions and take calculated risks to propel the business forward. Your role will involve balancing ease of collaboration with the need to avoid undue risk to Avanade. You will also balance the aggressive expansion of Avanade’s recurring platform business with providing customized, high-touch legal services for select clients who prefer traditional contract negotiations. As an independent advisor on legal and commercial risks, you will support Legal, Business, and Sales Leadership in shaping Avanade’s mid-market strategies. We achieve this by being bold, fresh, passionate, and optimistic. You will oversee the delivery of a variety of in-house legal services that support the business in achieving its goals while ensuring all areas of risk and compliance are managed effectively. You will collaborate with business management, business development executives, contract coordinators, internal business units, and other support functions. Key

title: S&C GN - Tech Strategy & Advisory - SAP MDG - Manager
jobDescription:
About Accenture: Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 750K people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com About Global Network: Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, every business is a digital business. Digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers, and communities how they manufacture and deliver products and services, and how they run their organizations. This is our unique differentiator. We seek people who recognize and understand the impact that digital, and technology have on every industry and every sector, and share our passion to shape unique strategies that allow our clients to succeed in this environment. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Global Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Approximately 10,000 consultants are part of this rapidly expanding network, providing specialized and strategic industry and functional consulting expertise from key locations around the world. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit www.accenture.com/capabilitynetwork. Capability Network Videos: Video title External link Accenture Global Network https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-92pv OH1d_k Accenture in One Word https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t1Fo8u NWZ-0 MBA Careers: What makes Accenture different https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5bg4u5Sczm8 Accenture Inclusion & The Power of Diversity https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2g88Ju6nkcg Practice Overview: Skill/Operating Group Technology Consulting Level Manager Location Gurgaon/Mumbai/Bangalore/Pune/Kolkata Travel Percentage Expected Travel could be anywhere between 0-100% Why Technology Consulting The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation. As technology rapidly evolves, it’s more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the client’s toughest business problems. Specialize in management or technology consulting to transform the world's leading organizations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by: Helping Clients: Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast-changing, customer-driven environments. Enhancing your Skillset: Building expertise and innovating with leading-edge technologies such as Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence and Cloud. Transforming Businesses: Developing customized, next-generation products and services that help clients shift to new business models designed for today's connected landscape of disruptive technologies Principal Duties And

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Working closely with our clients, Consulting professionals design, build and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance. They develop specialized expertise—strategic, industry, functional, technical—in a diverse project environment that offers multiple opportunities for career growth. The opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives are limitless in this ever-changing business landscape. Here are just a few of responsibilities. Lead strategic Fin Ops discussions with clients, identifying cost-saving opportunities and aligning cloud financial management with business objectives. Act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders including CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, and Cloud Center of Excellence teams. Analyze cloud and on-premise spend data to identify cost optimization opportunities across compute, storage, network, and licensing. Design and deliver cost governance models, optimization roadmaps, and actionable recommendations using Accenture’s IP and assets Support pre-sales and sales efforts by shaping Fin Ops propositions, building client pitches, and participating in proposal development. Identify and develop new Fin Ops opportunities within existing and new client accounts. Leverage strong cloud architecture knowledge (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, other CSPs) to recommend cost-efficient designs and architectures Knowledge of on-prem infrastructure cost modeling and software licensing optimization Key Competencies and Skills: The right candidate should have competency and skills aligned to one or more of these archetypes
- Strategic Fin Ops Expertise: Strong understanding of Fin Ops principles and ability to align cloud spend with business value, including budgeting, forecasting, and chargeback/showback models. Cloud Cost Optimization: Proven ability to identify, analyze, and deliver cost-saving opportunities across AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI and other CSP environments. Cloud Architecture Knowledge: Solid grasp of cloud-native services, architecture patterns, and cost-efficient design principles. Client & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to engage and influence senior business and technical stakeholders. title: S&C GN - Tech Strategy & Transformation - Transformation Coach - Senior Manager
jobDescription: Senior Manager – Transformation Office – Transformation Coach Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from technology Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network Areas of Work: Transformation Management, Transformation Coaching, Value Realization, Agentic AI Level: Senior Manager (Level 6) Location: Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai / Pune / Chennai / Kolkata / Hyderabad Years of Experience: 12 to 17 years Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture Are you passionate about shaping the early direction of large-scale transformation programs and building organizational muscles to sustain them? Do you excel at guiding senior leaders and cross-functional teams to define ways of working, embed governance practices, and drive transformation with discipline and clarity? If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation and take on a senior leadership role, guiding global clients on their most complex transformation journeys — working at the heart of our clients’ most ambitious programs to set the tone, build the foundation, and enable lasting transformation outcomes, now enhanced by the power of Agentic AI. The Practice – A Brief Sketch Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, redefining business models and delivery approaches. As a Senior Manager, you will be deployed at the critical early stages of transformation programs — shaping direction, enabling teams, and embedding the practices that make transformation stick. Here are some of the key initiatives you will drive: Establishing Strategic Direction for Early-Stage Transformation: Partnering with senior client leadership to define transformation vision, governance frameworks, and ways of working at program inception. Transformation Coaching & Team Enablement: Embedding alongside client teams to coach leaders and program workstreams on transformation management best practices, decision-making structures, and accountability models. Agentic AI-Powered Transformation Management: Identifying and deploying Agentic AI solutions within transformation programs to automate tracking, analysis, and realization of business value. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Manager who brings deep expertise in Transformation Management and a hands-on track record as a Transformation Coach. The ideal candidate excels at working in the early, ambiguous stages of large transformation programs — helping clients shape direction, define how the program will be managed, establish ways of working, and build the governance structures needed to execute with confidence. You will work closely with C-suite stakeholders, transformation leads, and program workstream owners to coach teams, embed best practices, and apply Agentic AI to accelerate program management maturity — ensuring measurable business outcomes are governed and realized throughout the transformation lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Transformation Coaching & Early-Stage Strategy Formulation Orchestrate Transformation Change– Guide and orchestrate enterprise-wide change across business units in close coordination with talent/HR teams, ensuring transformation approaches are shaped to client context, maturity, and archetype — enabling the organization to own and sustain the change rather than depending on externally imposed frameworks. Steer Culture & Accountability – Embed transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement, ensuring governance is actively practiced. Coach Leadership Teams – Guide senior leaders and workstream heads on transformation management principles, enabling effective decision-making, alignment, and disciplined execution. Build Capability – Build Transformation Management capability by enabling standard transformation orchestration guidelines, structured governance, change adoption, stakeholder alignment, and value realization to sustainably drive strategic change. Lead Transformation & Value Management Set up & Run TO – Set up and run Transformation Management Offices (TMO) / Value Realization Offices (VRO) for large-scale client engagements, owning governance, reporting, and value tracking end-to-end. Value Discovery & KPIs – Conduct and facilitate value discovery workshops to identify business objectives, key value drivers, and measurable KPIs during the business blueprint phase. Build detailed business cases for transformation initiatives, working with business and functional leaders to track and report actual performance against targets. Establish Program Governance – Design and embed program structures including decision cadences, escalation models, accountability frameworks, and standardized ways of working (meetings, reporting, RAID, decision registers). Embedding Best Practices & Sustaining Transformation Build Playbooks & Toolkits – Develop and institutionalize transformation playbooks, toolkits, and SOPs tailored to client context and maturity. Facilitate Health & Risk Reviews – Lead structured sessions to assess transformation health, identify risks, and co-create corrective actions. Drive Agentic AI-Powered Transformation Apply hands-on expertise in AI Agents and agentic architecture to automate and accelerate transformation management activities — including status tracking, risk identification, value analysis, and reporting. Identify opportunities within client programs where Agentic AI can meaningfully improve program governance, decision-making, and value realization speed. Articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption. Stay current with the evolving landscape of AI agent frameworks and proactively recommend their application within ongoing engagements. Stakeholder Engagement & Client Advisory Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and senior technology leaders, architecting and guiding transformation journeys with authority and clarity. Apply a cross-enterprise perspective spanning business and technology stakeholders, navigating ambiguity to pursue a consistent transformation vision. title: Acquisitions Legal Counsel Associate Manager
jobDescription:
Global Legal Network is a group of professionals operating globally from 12 countries. It provides a broad spectrum of differentiated services
- focused on delivering value and innovation. We partner with Legal teams across Accenture to build efficiencies and centers of excellence related to Legal services; and through our size, geographic spread and language diversity, the Global Legal Network is able to drive quality, agility and speed in our services, aligned to Accenture’s relentless focus on maximum efficiency and operational effectiveness. Ventures & Acquisitions (V&A) assists in the legal aspects of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures and strategic investment transactions, including due diligence, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating acquisitions documents, the target’s agreements and other documentation, advises on legal risks and mitigation alternatives associated with the transactions. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: We are an equal opportunity employer. We have an unwavering commitment to equality for all. Together, we are acting, we are leading, and we will drive change across the globe. JOB SUMMARY: Complexity: Requires analysis and solving of moderately complex problems. Typically creates new solutions, leveraging and, where needed, adapting existing methods and procedures. Requires understanding of the strategic direction set by senior management as it relates to team goals. Primary upward interaction is with direct supervisor or team leads. Generally, interacts with peers and/or management levels at a client and/or within Accenture. Authority: Requires minimal guidance when determining methods and procedures on new assignments. Impact or Decision: Decisions often impact the team in which they reside and occasionally impact other teams. Scope: Manages medium-small sized teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture. KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Provide legal support to Accenture’s M&A and strategic investment transactions, supporting legal due diligence exercises, identifying risks and mitigation plans, supporting Accenture’s M&A deal attorney in the negotiation of the transactions and the review of transactional documents in collaboration with legal and non-legal professionals supporting M&A and strategic investment transactions. Responsibly provide support to key Accenture M&A stakeholders including M&A deal attorney, Procurement Plus V&A, Contracting, Legal Integration teams and other Legal teams in different geographies. Document, review and draft the terms and conditions of different types of agreements and other documents relating to various target/acquired companies in accordance with company policies and procedures, applicable laws, and stakeholders’ requirements. Collaborate and coordinate with Accenture’s M&A deal attorney, Legal Integration Managers and Procurement Plus V&A Leads on the review of data room materials, in particular executed client, alliance and supplier agreements of the target companies. Train the team members and develop checklists and process documents for pre- and post-acquisition legal support. Directly liaising with internal stakeholders and deal teams on various legal and commercial issues. Maintain contract / subcontract compliance in line with company policies and procedures and ensures issues are resolved. Responsibly works at smaller engagements and/or works within team at a large, complex engagement.

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Law. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS: Minimum of 8 years of experience at law firm and/or as in-house counsel and experience in coordinating teamwork (or as individual contributor). Experience in M&A practice with strong knowledge of M&A transactions, due diligence exercises, general corporate business practices, commercial contracting regulations, subcontracting practices and ability to apply skills creatively to diverse stakeholder needs. Demonstrates ability to consistently and responsibly undertake contract drafting to a reasonable standard. Strong time-management, prioritization, organizational, problem solving skills. Displays a high level of responsiveness and follows through on commitments. Detail-oriented, sound judgement, organized, and flexible. Demonstrates a specialized subject-matter experience. BEHAVIOURS AND ATTRIBUTES: Open to work with and understand cross-cultures and locations throughout the Accenture global organization. Understand the value of diversity and recognize the strengths that different styles, innovative perspectives and experiences bring to Accenture. Demonstrate inclusion and respect for all individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, age, disability, culture, social status and/or sexuality. Leader as well as team player, collaborative and persuasive; able to work well with executives and non-executives. Identifies and suggests improved/innovative work processes or ways to improve client (internal and external) service. Suggests options for resolving issues and improving quality of work. title: Contract Manager
jobDescription:
Contract Management is part of our Legal and Commercial Services. Our professionals bring innovative ideas to commercial reality with a focus on maximizing value for all parties through a deep understanding of legal, business and commercial risks. We work alongside Accenture sales and delivery teams throughout the entire contract lifecycle to provide high quality advice and support for negotiation, drafting and ongoing management of client contracts. We apply commercial and contractual expertise to lead the delivery of legal & commercial outcomes for our priority engagements and portfolios, including: · Sales growth: expanding the footprint of our agreements and supporting new business; · Revenue protection: delivering on our contractual commitments; · Margin improvement: effectively managing commercial levers, risks and issues; and · Compliance with contract obligations and Accenture policy. title: Contract Manager
jobDescription:
Contract Management is part of our Legal and Commercial Services. Our professionals bring innovative ideas to commercial reality with a focus on maximizing value for all parties through a deep understanding of legal, business and commercial risks. We work alongside Accenture sales and delivery teams throughout the entire contract lifecycle to provide high quality advice and support for negotiation, drafting and ongoing management of client contracts. We apply commercial and contractual expertise to lead the delivery of legal & commercial outcomes for our priority engagements and portfolios, including: · Sales growth: expanding the footprint of our agreements and supporting new business; · Revenue protection: delivering on our contractual commitments; · Margin improvement: effectively managing commercial levers, risks and issues; and · Compliance with contract obligations and Accenture policy.
